enchantments.tooltip: Spellcasting Implement +36: Passive: +36 Implement bonus to Universal Spell Power.
+12 Enhancement Bonus: +12 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Evocation Focus V: +5 Equipment bonus to the DC of Evocation spells.
Kinetic Lore X: Passive: Your Force, Physical and Untyped spells gain a 20% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Impulse +150: Passive: +150 Equipment bonus to Force, Untyped, Slashing, Piercing, and Bludgeoning Spell Power.
Wizardry XI: This item grants the wearer +275 maximum spell points. Sorcerers and Favored Souls gain up to double spell points from items.
Flametouched Iron: Flametouched Iron grants +1 saves versus Evil Outsiders.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
